question: Which of the following places is NOT located on the banks of river Ganga?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hazaribagh**__.

__
 
• **Hazaribagh** is **NOT located** on the banks of river **Ganga.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Hazaribagh** is a city and a **municipal corporation **in the **Hazaribagh district** in the **Indian state** of **Jharkhand**.
 
• It is the **divisional headquarters** of the **North Chotanagpur division.**
 
• **Hazaribagh** is located geographically near the **Chotanagpur Plateau**.
